training.positive_negative_pairs: Within each TRAIN query's baseline top-3 candidates, pair the relevant document against every non-relevant candidate. Queries whose positive is absent from top-3 contribute no pair and remain visible in candidate-recall metrics.

integrity: Do not change candidate depth, features, feature definitions, seed, epochs, optimizer, learning rate, weight decay, or loss after the first reranker result is inspected. The M10.1 document/query/qrel split remains unchanged.
